proposals.evidence: Full CDIAL musala section 2 is explicitly *muṣala or *muśala and gives West Pahari muśḷ/muśḷī pestle and Jaunsari mūśṛī, with the addendum again giving muśḷ. The survey ś-medial lateral pestle forms preserve the diagnostic sibilant of this branch; regional IA transmission is unresolved. This selects the combined canonical section 10223-2, not the separate database variant node *muśala. Exact response: muślo.
